description: A NEW historical RESEARCH proxy, built by forward-selecting PIT-safe enrichment components onto MLB-RSCH-0008's simple proxy (unchanged): stabilized offense, bullpen quality, and park/run-environment. Starting-pitcher quality (M2) is EXCLUDED -- Phase A empirically found historical starter identity is not PIT-safe at scale (0.6% mismatch rate, below the 1% preregistered floor).
name: mlb_rsch_0009_enriched_proxy_v1
